Revise the current room under the original task constraints. Current objects exist even if action history is empty or unavailable. Use exact object IDs and callable catalog IDs. Units are metres; yaw is degrees about +Z. You may produce a short <think> decision describing conditions, applicable source knowledge, intended changes and expected costs/unknowns. Then emit exactly one <tool_call>{"name":"...","arguments":{...}}</tool_call>, or <done> with unmet/unknown requirements and no call. Do not claim unmeasured success.
Available executable tools:
[{"description":"Move existing furniture to a new floor position.

Furniture sits flat on the floor at z=0 with upright orientation.
You can only control the x, y position and yaw rotation (rotation
around the vertical axis).

Use this to relocate furniture that's already in the room. You need
the object ID from when you placed it or from 'get_current_scene_state'.","name":"move_furniture_tool","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"object_id":{"description":"ID of the furniture item to move.","title":"Object Id","type":"string"},"x":{"description":"New X position in the room (meters).","title":"X","type":"number"},"y":{"description":"New Y position in the room (meters).","title":"Y","type":"number"},"yaw":{"default":0.0,"description":"New yaw rotation in degrees around vertical axis (default: 0.0).
Positive values rotate counterclockwise in top-down view.","title":"Yaw","type":"number"}},"required":["object_id","x","y","yaw"],"title":"move_furniture_tool_args","type":"object"}}]
